images.title: Where the smallest and the biggest go
images.purpose: Show that the arrows decide the corners: with every row and column increasing, 1 goes top left and 4 bottom right; with rows increasing and columns decreasing, 4 goes top right and 1 bottom left. The other two cells are blanks to fill.
images.composition: Two 2 by 2 grids with the word inc beside each row and inc or dec under each column, the smallest and the biggest number placed and two blank cells in each grid.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two 2 by 2 grids side by side, each with arrow words written beside the rows and under the columns. Each grid is four square cells 190 by 190 px, every cell outlined dark #2B2B2B 4 px. LEFT GRID: a block x 150 to 530, y 160 to 540. The top left cell (x 150 to 340, y 160 to 350) holds 1 and the bottom right cell (x 340 to 530, y 350 to 540) holds 4, each cell filled teal #0072B2 with the digit in white bold sans-serif (96 px) centred; the top right cell (x 340 to 530, y 160 to 350) and the bottom left cell (x 150 to 340, y 350 to 540) are BLANK: white, empty. To the right of each row, at x 600, a rounded tag (120 by 64 px, outlined reddish purple #CC79A7 4 px) with the word inc in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px): one at y 255 and one at y 445. Under each column, at y 595, the same tag with the word inc: one at x 245 and one at x 435. RIGHT GRID: a block x 800 to 1180, y 160 to 540. The top right cell (x 990 to 1180, y 160 to 350) holds 4 and the bottom left cell (x 800 to 990, y 350 to 540) holds 1, each filled teal #0072B2 with the digit in white bold sans-serif (96 px) centred; the top left cell and the bottom right cell are BLANK: white, empty. To the right of each row, at x 1250, the same tag with the word inc: one at y 255 and one at y 445. Under each column, at y 595, the same tag with the word dec: one at x 895 and one at x 1085. Under the left grid, centred at x 340, y 710, the caption 1 top left, 4 bottom right in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (40 px); under the right grid, centred at x 990, y 710, the caption 4 top right, 1 bottom left in the same style. No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any digit in a blank cell
a digit other than 1 and 4 in each grid
any word other than inc and dec on the arrow tags
dec on the rows of the right grid or inc on its columns
images.takeaway: The arrows tell where the smallest and the biggest number go: 1 top left and 4 bottom right when everything increases; 4 top right and 1 bottom left when rows increase and columns decrease.
images.description: Two 2 by 2 grids with inc beside the rows and under the columns of the first, and inc beside the rows and dec under the columns of the second, with 1 and 4 placed and two blank cells each.
images.context: Concept image for Filling a Grid in Order, using the example's own numbers (practice values). The arrows are written the way the book writes them, so the grid puzzle that follows looks familiar.
images.teaching_notes: Point at the first cell of every row and column, place the smallest and the biggest, then fill the two blanks by checking every row and every column. The slip to watch: checking only the rows.

image_decisions.why: The two grids with their arrows show where the smallest and the biggest number must go, and the blanks are the puzzle in miniature.
